Use this when the app, rather than the agent, decides what may be kept: for example when the end user has to consent to being recorded before anything about the call can be stored. The value stays in effect until the client sends a different one, so it only needs to be sent when the answer changes. Whatever is in effect when a turn completes decides that turn, both whether its audio reaches the recording bucket and whether its transcript reaches conversation history, BigQuery and Cloud Logging. It covers the agent's side of the turn as well as the end user's. Turns that complete before the client first sends this are recorded according to the app's logging settings, as though the field did not exist. enumDescriptions: The conflict resolution strategy is unspecified.

done.description: If the value is `false`, it means the operation is still in progress. If `true`, the operation is completed, and either `error` or `response` is available.

name.description: The server-assigned name, which is only unique within the same service that originally returns it. If you use the default HTTP mapping, the `name` should be a resource name ending with `operations/{unique_id}`.

response.description: The normal, successful response of the operation. If the original method returns no data on success, such as `Delete`, the response is `google.protobuf.Empty`. If the original method is standard `Get`/`Create`/`Update`, the response should be the resource. For other methods, the response should have the type `XxxResponse`, where `Xxx` is the original method name. For example, if the original method name is `TakeSnapshot()`, the inferred response type is `TakeSnapshotResponse`.

additionalProperties.description: Properties of the object. Contains field @type with type URL.

Operation.description: This resource represents a long-running operation that is the result of a network API call.

handoff.description: Tells the client to silently reconnect with resume_from_sequence_number: the task serving this stream is going away and the turn will continue elsewhere. Not an error; the stream completes normally after this event.

thoughtChunk.description: Thought text chunk (agent's reasoning before generating response).

turnMetadata.description: Optional. Turn-level metadata and intent categorization.

sequenceNumber.description: Optional. Monotonically increasing sequence number for this session turn.

turnCompleted.description: The turn has ended. Sent as the last event of every turn, on the original stream and on every attached or resumed stream, so clients can end the turn on an explicit signal instead of inferring it from stream closure.

sessionCheckpoint.description: Session checkpoint/compaction recap event containing user intent and rolling summary.

resumeSnapshot.description: A compacted replay of an in-flight turn, sent as the first event of every attach or resume before any live event. The client replaces any locally rendered state for this turn with the snapshot's contents.

confirmationRequest.description: A blocking confirmation the agent paused on. The agent resumes when the answer arrives on a later request's `confirmation_response`. Only sent to clients that declared the CONFIRMATION_CARDS capability on the request.

turnInProgress.description: Optional. Indicates whether the turn is still actively running in the background.

artifactChunk.description: Generated-document artifact event (live preview deltas + final Cloud Storage pointer).

textChunk.description: Text Token (for streaming Gemini responses word-by-word).

optionQuestionsChunk.description: Structured clarification options parsed out of the model turn. The console renders these as a selectable option list instead of raw text.

voiceId.description: Optional. The specific voice identifier/accent to use. Example: "en-US-Wavenet-D" or "en-GB-Standard-A"

enumDescriptions: Background environment unspecified.

speakingRate.description: Optional. The speaking rate. 1.0 is normal. Lower is slower (e.g., 0.8), higher is faster (e.g., 1.5). Useful for testing how the agent handles fast talkers.

appUri.description: The [Google Cloud Storage](https://cloud.google.com/storage/docs/) URI to which the app was exported.

appContent.description: App folder compressed as a zip file.

callCount.description: Output only. The number of times the resource was called.

AssistantConfirmationRequestTarget.description: One resource the confirmed action will change.

resource.description: The resource that will change, as a full resource name.

targetApp.description: The app the resource belongs to, or empty for a location-scoped action such as creating an app. Format: `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/apps/{app}`

displayName.description: Display name of the resource or app, for the card.

etag.description: Etag used to ensure the object hasn't changed during a read-modify-write operation. If the etag is empty, the update will overwrite any concurrent changes.

description.description: Optional. Human-readable description of the example.

invalid.description: Output only. The example may become invalid if referencing resources are deleted. Invalid examples will not be used as few-shot examples.

messages.description: Optional. The collection of messages that make up the conversation.

createTime.description: Output only. Timestamp when the example was created.

updateTime.description: Output only. Timestamp when the example was last updated.

entryAgent.description: Optional. The agent that initially handles the conversation. If not specified, the example represents a conversation that is handled by the root agent. Format: `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/apps/{app}/agents/{agent}`

Example.description: An example represents a sample conversation between the user and the agent(s).

ConnectorToolset.description: A toolset that generates tools from an Integration Connectors Connection.

connection.description: Required. The full resource name of the referenced Integration Connectors Connection. Format: `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/connections/{connection}`

authConfig.description: Optional. Configures how authentication is handled in Integration Connectors. By default, an admin authentication is passed in the Integration Connectors API requests. You can override it with a different end-user authentication config. **Note**: The Connection must have authentication override enabled in order to specify an EUC configuration here - otherwise, the Toolset creation will fail. See: https://cloud.google.com/application-integration/docs/configure-connectors-task#configure-authentication-override

connectorActions.description: Required. The list of connector actions/entity operations to generate tools for.

score.description: Output only. The average hallucination score (0 to 1).

inputModes.description: The set of supported input media types for this skill, overriding the agent's defaults.

examples.description: Example prompts or scenarios that this skill can handle.

name.description: Required. A human-readable name for the skill.

description.description: Required. A detailed description of the skill.

outputModes.description: The set of supported output media types for this skill, overriding the agent's defaults.

tags.description: Required. A set of keywords describing the skill's capabilities.

id.description: Required. A unique identifier for the agent's skill.

AgentSkill.description: Represents a distinct capability or function that an agent can perform.

event.description: Required. The name of the event.

variables.description: Optional. Additional variables associated with the event.

datasetId.description: Optional. The insights dataset to be used to fetch conversation data for generating the evaluations. Format: `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/datasets/{dataset}`.

nextPageToken.description: A token that can be sent as ListScheduledEvaluationRunsRequest.page_token to retrieve the next page. Absence of this field indicates there are no subsequent pages.

scheduledEvaluationRuns.description: The list of scheduled evaluation runs.

toolsets.description: Optional. List of toolsets in the app.

tools.description: Optional. List of tools in the app.

agents.description: Optional. List of agents in the app.

guardrails.description: Optional. List of guardrails in the app.

examples.description: Optional. List of examples in the app.

app.description: Optional. The basic settings for the app.
